title: Chicken or Turkey Caesar Garden Salad, No Dressing

content.title: About
content.content: The Chicken or Turkey Caesar Garden Salad is a light dish made with fresh lettuce, tomato, cheese and grilled chicken, turkey or a mix of both. No dressing is added, allowing you to control fat and calorie intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The classic Caesar is usually made with chicken, but many chefs use turkey for a milder flavor.
Romaine lettuce, the base of this salad, is rich in vitamins A and K.
Tomatoes add bright color and vitamin C, which enhances iron absorption from the meat.
Hard cheese such as Parmesan provides a distinctive aroma and calcium in small amounts.
Skipping the dressing makes the dish suitable for low‑fat dietary plans.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Chicken and turkey are excellent sources of high‑quality protein needed for muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: The absence of dressing and the use of lean meat keep the overall fat intake low.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Lettuce, tomato and cheese supply vitamins A, C, K and calcium, supporting immunity and bone health.

items.title: Promotes satiety
items.content: The combination of protein, fiber from the greens, and a modest amount of cheese helps you feel full longer.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: The vegetables in the salad have a low glycemic index, helping to stabilize blood sugar levels.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Cheese may trigger allergic reactions in people with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Pre‑shredded cheeses often contain added salt; choose low‑sodium varieties to keep sodium intake moderate.

items.title: Meat safety
items.content: Undercooked chicken or turkey can cause foodborne illness; ensure the meat is fully cooked.

items.title: Pesticide residues
items.content: Tomatoes and lettuce may carry pesticide residues; wash them thoroughly before use.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the salad chilled as a standalone meal or with whole‑grain bread. If desired, a light squeeze of lemon or a drizzle of olive oil can be added, though that changes the original no‑dressing concept.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared salad in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. Store the meat separately if you need longer storage to prevent bacterial growth.
